title: Indoor VOC Explorer

hardware.candidate: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 N8R8 plus SGP40 and BME280 3.3-V I2C breakout modules

supplementaryRequirements: VOC index is a relative trend with warm-up/baseline behavior; no CO2, PM or life-safety claims.

tests.name: Use RH/temperature compensation and checksum validation
tests.procedure: Log compensated raw signals and measurement timing
tests.acceptance: SGP40 readings accepted with algorithm input evidence

tests.name: Run a documented baseline warm-up
tests.procedure: Log sample interval, warm-up duration and VOC index
tests.acceptance: VOC trend appears only after valid warm-up

tests.name: Ventilate room under nonhazardous conditions
tests.procedure: Record trend before/after using reference conditions
tests.acceptance: Trend changes recorded, no false quantitative CO2 statement

tests.name: Disconnect either sensor with power off; restart
tests.procedure: Observe invalid compensation and stale state
tests.acceptance: System shows invalid rather than fabricated index
